P.name: Bravado
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Taric''' empowers his next two {{tip|basic attacks}} within 5 seconds to each gain {{sti|as|{{as|100% '''total''' attack speed}}}}, deal {{as|{{pp|25 + (93-25)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-attack}}, and reduce the {{sti|'''remaining''' cooldowns}} of his basic abilities by {{pp|1;( 1 + ( ( x * 10 ) / ( ( x * 10 ) + 100 ) ) );2|0;10 to 100 for 10;∞|label1= AH|type=ability haste|formula= 1 + ( Haste / ( Haste + 100 ) )}}
 seconds.

Q.name: Starlight's Touch
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' {{tip|heals}} himself and nearby allied champions for {{as|25|heal}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} {{as|(+ 1% of his '''maximum''' health)}} per charge of ''Starlight's Touch'' that he periodically [[ammunition|stocks]], up to a maximum amount. ''{{ais|Bravado|Taric}}'' empowered attacks each grant one charge.
Q.description2: ''Starlight's Touch'' can heal up to a maximum of {{as|125|heal}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}} {{as|(+ 5% of '''Taric's''' '''maximum''' health)}} at 5 charges.

W.name: Bastion
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Taric''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and forms a {{tip|tether}} between him and the ally bound by ''Bastion''. While the tether persists, the ally also gains the {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} and '''Taric's''' abilities are mimicked to them, though the effects do not stack.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' grants himself and the target allied champion a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, binding them with ''Bastion''.
W.description3: '''Taric''' can also [[self-targeted|self-cast]] to shield himself; if he self-casts and is untethered, he will become tethered to the nearest ally. Similarly, if he is tethered to an ally and self-casts, both he and the ally will be shielded. Only one ally can be bound at a time, and selecting a new ally overrides the previous bind.

E.name: Dazzle
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' winds up over 1 second, granting {{tip|ghosting}} to nearby units, then projects a beam of starlight in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|stuns}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

R.name: Cosmic Radiance
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' calls down a star from above that descends to him over {{fd|2.5}} seconds. Afterwards, he and nearby allied champions become {{tip|invulnerable}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
